Serialization and deserialization of BPF VM input parameters and account regions.

# Purpose
This file implements serialization and deserialization of the BPF loader input region for instruction execution. It builds the VM input buffer from instruction account data, account metadata, and instruction data, then restores account state after execution. The code supports two account layouts: an aligned format for the current loader and an unaligned format for the deprecated loader. It also handles duplicate instruction accounts, writable and read-only account checks, lamport updates, owner updates, and account data length changes.

The file also supports three execution modes controlled by `stricter_abi_and_runtime_constraints` and `account_data_direct_mapping`. In the legacy mode, account data is copied into one contiguous buffer. In the stricter ABI mode, the input region is split into separate memory regions for metadata and account data. In direct mapping mode, account data is mapped directly from the borrowed account storage instead of being copied into the input buffer. The helper functions [`new_input_mem_region`](<#new_input_mem_region>), [`write_account`](<#write_account>), [`fd_bpf_loader_input_serialize_parameters`](<#fd_bpf_loader_input_serialize_parameters>), and [`fd_bpf_loader_input_deserialize_parameters`](<#fd_bpf_loader_input_deserialize_parameters>) form the public entry points for this serialization logic.
